telephony.notes: Carrier PSTN / SIP trunk trunking leg cost

twm_speech.notes: Official Taiwan Mobile / Bronci quotation (tax inclusive)

text_llm.notes: Estimated converted to TWD at 31.5 USD/TWD

native_voice_realtime.notes: Native speech-to-speech token rates converted to TWD

storage_and_recording.notes: Dual-channel audio recording and checkpoint index retention

human_agent_amortized.notes: Ops call center dispatch labor cost for exception handoff/callback

calculation_rules.modular_call_cost: telephony_leg + twm_realtime_asr + text_llm + twm_tts + storage_checkpoint + (handoff_minutes * human_agent_labor)
calculation_rules.denominator_rule: SA §10.2: Cohort cost denominator must include all attempted calls establishing intent, including dropouts and failed dispatches.
